Oktoberfest @ Seapine!

Liter steins of Munich Mist lager on the patio is the perfect way to get a taste of the German Fest season in Seattle!

$12 liters & $12 4-packs of Munich Mist for the Oktoberfest season at our taproom in Sodo!

Try Seapine at the source!

Visit the Seapine tasting room at our brewery in Sodo! We’re located about 1 mile south of T-Mobile Park @ 2959 Utah Ave S.

Try our range of lagers, IPAs and seasonally rotating special brews in a unique, rustic environment tucked away just off 1st Ave S.

Join us on a gameday for a pint: easy access to T-Mobile Park & Lumen Field from the taproom!

Taproom Hours

MONDAY | 3PM–9PM
TUESDAY–THURSDAY | NOON–9PM
FRIDAY & SATURDAY | NOON–10PM
SUNDAY | NOON–8PM

$5 Gameday Lager

1/2 liter steins of our award-winning light lager are $5 every time there’s a sporting event in Sodo! Swing by the taproom the next time you’re heading to a game!
